mapper.select: SELECT order_id,payload_hash FROM bike_domestic_sku_order WHERE operator_id=#{operatorId} AND request_id=#{requestId}

SELECT s.id sku_id,s.sku_code,m.id model_id,m.model_name,s.product_name,s.specification, i.ordered_qty,i.shipped_qty,i.closed_qty,s.customs_model FROM bike_order_reservation_item i JOIN bike_production_sku s ON s.id=i.sku_id JOIN bike_product_model m ON m.id=s.model_id WHERE i.order_id=#{orderId} ORDER BY i.sku_id

SELECT src.lock_id,l.lock_no,src.sku_id,src.quantity,src.expires_at,src.renewed_expires_at FROM bike_domestic_order_lock_source src JOIN bike_inventory_lock l ON l.id=src.lock_id WHERE src.order_id=#{orderId} ORDER BY src.lock_id
mapper.update: UPDATE bike_domestic_order_lock_source src JOIN bike_order_reservation r ON r.order_id=src.order_id SET src.renewed_expires_at=r.expires_at,src.expiry_audited_at=NULL WHERE src.order_id=#{orderId}
mapper.select: SELECT src.order_id,src.lock_id,o.order_no,l.lock_no,s.sku_code, COALESCE(src.renewed_expires_at,src.expires_at) expires_at,src.quantity-src.shipped_qty remaining_qty FROM bike_domestic_order_lock_source src JOIN bike_order_reservation r ON r.order_id=src.order_id JOIN bike_sales_order o ON o.id=src.order_id JOIN bike_inventory_lock l ON l.id=src.lock_id JOIN bike_production_sku s ON s.id=src.sku_id WHERE r.hold_mode='TIMED' AND o.status IN ('DRAFT','PENDING','CONFIRMED','PARTIAL_SHIPPED') AND src.expiry_audited_at IS NULL AND src.quantity>src.shipped_qty AND COALESCE(src.renewed_expires_at,src.expires_at)<=NOW(3) ORDER BY expires_at,src.order_id,src.lock_id LIMIT 200
mapper.update: UPDATE bike_domestic_order_lock_source SET expiry_audited_at=NOW(3) WHERE order_id=#{orderId} AND lock_id=#{lockId} AND expiry_audited_at IS NULL

SELECT s.id sku_id,s.sku_code,m.model_name,s.product_name,s.specification FROM bike_production_sku s JOIN bike_product_model m ON m.id=s.model_id WHERE s.enabled=1 AND m.enabled=1
AND (s.sku_code LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR s.product_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR m.model_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%'))
ORDER BY s.id DESC LIMIT 100
